listings.thesis: HBM/DRAM tightness links directly to AI accelerator supply, but memory cycles and capex timing are major risks.

priorCase.rankRationale: Memory-tier bottleneck (HBM crowding out commodity DRAM, shortage to 2028) is fully intact but well-broadcast; the +25% move since June 9 is a flow/cycle bounce, not new evidence. Custom AI-memory trial results are a 2H26 catalyst, not yet de-risked. Hold.

listings.thesis: Memory recovery rather than CPO alpha.

priorCase.rankRationale: Nanya Technology should move down because HBM, server DRAM and AI eSSD supply is either less hidden after 64.0% YTD, less direct to CPO/HBM/package/test bottlenecks, or more exposed to cycle/valuation risk than the current rank 82 implies.
